requestText: Please provide the complete current Arizona Complete Health-Complete Care integrated preferred drug list, including additional plan products beyond the AHCCCS statewide list, with effective/revision date, PA, age, step-therapy and quantity-limit flags; also provide current drug-specific PA criteria for products not covered by the publicly posted criteria. The currently linked JSON declares 2022 and omits current named products.
separatePopulationSupplements: Crisis, SABG and dualOTC files retained as currently linked sources with printed dates; not substitutes for full integrated PDL or MedicarePartD formulary.
